title: feat: serve legacy text cache misses from the worker at 10%
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The legacy text cache Worker can now handle cache misses directly for an `ADAPTER_SHARE` of 10%; remaining misses still route to the VM. Responses identify the route with `X-Legacy-Path: worker` or `vm`. The Worker reproduces the VM’s routes, request parameters, plain-text, OpenAI JSON and SSE responses, error responses, 304/431/preflight behavior, Weft paywall challenge, /24 blocklist and per-IP free limit. It calls gen through the `GEN` binding and accepts compressed request bodies and character encodings. The public `/feed` preserves VM-style events without exposing private requests; it remains routed to the VM at this share, and listeners with more than 1 MB unsent are disconnected. Intentional differences include using `CF-Connecting-IP` for limits and blocks, completing responses beyond 125 seconds, standard query parsing, no feed password mode or `x-enter-token` bypass, no stack traces on error pages, and treating limiter failures as free requests. Gen requests no longer include `voice` or `jsonMode:false`. All 73 tests pass; a local end-to-end comparison matched responses, feed events and billing, including one gen call and debit per generation and neither on 402, 404, 429 or invalid-body responses.

image.prompt: In a cozy garden server room, Polli wears a tiny tool belt and helps a CRT monitor robot route little text-message sprites between a glowing lime green (#ecf874) Worker terminal and an older VM terminal, with code-plants growing beside them. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small within the scene, in strictly pixel art style, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, chunky sprites, warm cream background and dark purple (#110518) outlines; nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
